title: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design
title_zh: DRYLAB-Bench：智能体大语言模型生物安全风险评估基准

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial benefits for research but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as the engineering of enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While international biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk posed by LLMs in executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when models are augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess the possession of hazardous knowledge rather than its practical application, overlook the risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on validation methods that are either unreliable, prohibitively expensive, or inherently hazardous. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench ( D esign R isk Y ielded by L LM A gent in B iodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. Moving beyond basic question-answering, DRYLAB-Bench tasks agents with 30 genuinely hazardous mutation-design scenarios distilled from biosecurity guidelines. It evaluates models in a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where LLMs orchestrate BDTs to iteratively refine candidates. Crucially, it scores submitted designs directly against 187,695 187{,}695 empirical wet-lab measurements from ProteinGym and ViroGym through our proposed Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), which quantifies the risk-associated effects of submitted mutations while enabling scalable and safe ground-truth verification. Evaluations of 15 frontier models reveal substantial baseline threats: without tools, 67.6% of one-shot designs exceed the average measured variant, and 21.4% reach the highest-risk decile. Equipping models with BDTs significantly amplifies this risk, raising the pooled risk by Δ ​ B ​ R ​ S = + 0.116 \Delta BRS=+0.116 and the top-decile share to 23.5%. Code is available at: https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench .

paragraphs.en: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, these models are beginning to acquire biological design ability ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . While these capabilities offer substantial benefits for biological research, they simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as the engineering of enhanced viral pathogens or the creation of drug-resistant bacteria. Consequently, multiple international biosecurity frameworks and policies have identified malicious biological modification as a critical threat ( World Health Organization, 2022 ; Office of Science and Technology Policy, 2024 ; Executive Office of the President, 2023 ; Executive Office of the President, 2025 ) . However, the actual magnitude of risk posed by LLMs in executing such modifications remains unquantified. Furthermore, the integration of specialized biological design tools (BDTs) into LLM workflows has the potential to significantly amplify this threat.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的能力持续进步，这些模型开始具备生物设计能力（Kim 等，2026）。 尽管这些能力为生物学研究带来了显著益处，但同时也引入了严重的双重用途风险，例如改造增强型病毒病原体或创造耐药性细菌。 因此，多个国际生物安全框架和政策已将恶意生物改造认定为关键威胁（世界卫生组织，2022；科学技术政策办公室，2024；总统执行办公室，2023；总统执行办公室，2025）。 然而，LLM在执行此类改造时所造成的实际风险程度仍未得到量化。 此外，将专门的生物设计工具（BDT）整合到LLM的工作流程中，可能会显著放大这一威胁。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluations exhibit several critical limitations. Primarily, knowledge-based benchmarks, such as WMDP ( Li et al., 2024 ) and VCT ( Götting et al., 2025 ) , assess whether LLMs possess hazardous information but fail to evaluate their ability to apply this knowledge to concrete tasks, leaving the actual operational risk unmeasured. Furthermore, while task-level evaluations like ABC-Bench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) cover fragment design, screening evasion, and lab-robot scripting, only the screening-evasion task addresses dual-use concerns. More importantly, such frameworks restrict agents to general-purpose software lacking the capacity to score candidates for hazardous properties. Consequently, any malicious design choices rely solely on the model’s intrinsic knowledge, leaving the risk amplification contributed by specialized BDTs entirely unmeasured. Finally, the evaluation of open-ended design tasks currently relies on inherently unreliable LLM judges, prohibitively expensive expert reviews, or physically hazardous wet-lab synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的评估方法存在若干关键性局限。 首先，基于知识的基准测试（如 WMDP（Li et al., 2024）和 VCT（Götting et al., 2025））仅能判断大型语言模型是否掌握危险信息，却无法评估其将这些知识应用于具体任务的能力，因此实际运行风险仍无法衡量。 此外，尽管 ABC-Bench（Liu et al., 2026）等任务级评估涵盖了片段设计、筛查规避以及实验室机器人脚本编写，但其中只有筛查规避任务涉及双重用途问题。 更重要的是，此类框架将智能体限制在通用软件中，而这类软件缺乏对候选方案进行危险属性评分的能力。 因此，任何恶意的设计选择都完全依赖模型自身的内在知识，而专用生物检测工具（BDT）所带来的风险放大效应则完全未被衡量。 最后，当前对开放式设计任务的评估要么依赖本身不可靠的大型语言模型评判者，要么依赖成本高昂的专家审查，甚至需要借助存在物理风险的湿实验室合成方法。

paragraphs.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench , the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. DRYLAB-Bench directly addresses the aforementioned limitations through a three-fold approach: 1) Genuinely hazardous scenarios : Moving beyond basic question-answering or screening tasks, our benchmark specifically evaluates the real-world threat posed by LLMs executing hazardous mutation-design tasks. 2) BDT-integrated malicious workflows : We evaluate models within a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where the LLM orchestrates specialized BDTs, such as EVEscape ( Thadani et al., 2023 ) , to propose, evaluate, and iteratively refine candidate sequences. This setup explicitly captures the risk amplification introduced by BDTs. 3) Reliable and safe validation : To circumvent the unreliability of LLM judges and the biosecurity hazards of physical synthesis, DRYLAB-Bench scores design outputs directly against empirical wet-lab measurements compiled in ProteinGym ( Notin et al., 2023 ) and ViroGym ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . By leveraging 187,695 187{,}695 experimentally measured single-amino-acid substitutions across 30 scenarios, our benchmark provides scalable, ground-truth verification. Based on these measurements, we introduce the Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), a ground-truth-based metric that quantifies the risk-associated effects of LLM-prioritized mutation designs without relying on subjective model-based evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了 DRYLAB-Bench——首个旨在评估 LLM 智能体在高风险生物突变设计方面能力的综合性基准测试。 DRYLAB-Bench 通过三重方法直接解决了上述局限性：1）真正危险的场景：我们的基准测试超越了基础问答或筛选任务，专门评估 LLM 在执行危险突变设计任务时可能带来的现实威胁。2）集成 BDT 的恶意工作流程：我们在一个多轮、工具增强的环境中对模型进行评估，其中 LLM 会协调使用专门的 BDT（如 EVEscape（Thadani 等人，2023）），以提出、评估并迭代优化候选序列。 这种设置明确捕捉到了 BDT 所引入的风险放大效应。3）可靠且安全的验证：为避免 LLM 评判者的不可靠性以及物理合成带来的生物安全风险，DRYLAB-Bench 直接根据 ProteinGym（Notin 等人，2023）和 ViroGym（Zhou 等人，2026）中汇总的经验性湿实验测量结果对设计输出进行评分。 通过利用 187,695 个在 30 种场景下经实验测定的单氨基酸替换数据，我们的基准测试提供了可扩展的、基于真实数据的验证方法。 基于这些测量结果，我们提出了生物安全风险评分（BRS）——一种基于真实数据的指标，用于量化 LLM 优先选择的突变设计所带来的风险相关影响，而无需依赖主观的模型内评估。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments demonstrate that frontier models already possess a substantial capacity for high-risk mutation design, posing a severe latent threat to biosecurity. Even without tool augmentation, all evaluated models surpass average design baselines. Notably, GPT-5.6 Sol’s one-shot W285T design emerged as the single highest-risk variant among the 3,372 measured in the SRC activation assay of ProteinGym. When models are granted access to BDTs and multi-round iteration, this baseline threat is significantly amplified. For instance, in the PsaE disruption scenario, the designs submitted by GPT-5.6 Terra shifted from outranking 11.7% of the measured variants to outranking 98.9%.

sents.en: For instance, in the PsaE disruption scenario, the designs submitted by GPT-5.6 Terra shifted from outranking 11.7% of the measured variants to outranking 98.9%.

paragraphs.en: Previous biosecurity evaluations primarily focused on scientific knowledge like WMDP ( Li et al., 2024 ) and safety alignment, employing question-answering formats to test refusal rates (e.g., VCT ( Götting et al., 2025 ) , and various safety suites ( Ackerman et al., 2025 ; Weidener et al., 2026 ; Arora et al., 2026 ; Ali et al., 2026 ) ) or assessing simple sequence reconstruction. Recent works ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Black et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Barkan et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) have advanced this paradigm by evaluating LLMs equipped with biological tools for bio-coding and screening evasion. However, these evaluations remain constrained by a limited agentic scope. Rather than assessing whether an agent can iteratively conceptualize and refine mutations to achieve hazardous functional phenotypes, they typically either evaluate the mere possession of dangerous knowledge or restrict tool usage to peripheral task stages unrelated to the core malicious objective. As a result, they fail to capture the extent to which biological tools amplify an LLM’s dangerous capabilities. The actual risk of LLMs autonomously navigating complex biological fitness landscapes therefore remains unquantified.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的生物安全评估主要关注科学知识（如 WMDP，Li 等人，2024）和安全对齐问题，采用问答形式测试拒绝率（例如 VCT，Götting 等人，2025；以及多种安全套件，Ackerman 等人，2025；Weidener 等人，2026；Arora 等人，2026；Ali 等人，2026），或评估简单的序列重建能力。 近期的研究（Liu 等人，2026；Lee 等人，2026a；Black 等人，2026；Lee 等人，2026b；Barkan 等人，2026；Cai 等人，2026）通过评估配备生物工具、能够进行生物编码和筛选规避的大语言模型，推动了这一范式的进步。 然而，这些评估仍受限于智能体作用范围的局限性。 它们并未评估智能体能否迭代地构想并优化突变以实现有害的功能表型，而是通常仅评估其是否具备危险知识，或将工具使用限制在与核心恶意目标无关的边缘任务阶段。 因此，这些评估未能揭示生物工具在多大程度上增强了大语言模型的潜在危险性。 因此，大语言模型自主探索复杂生物适应度景观的实际风险仍未得到量化。

paragraphs.en: Beyond task design, existing biosecurity benchmarks ( Mitchener et al., 2025 ; Marshall et al., 2026 ) are fundamentally constrained by their verification paradigms. Prior works typically rely on one of three validation mechanisms, each exhibiting critical flaws. First, pre-defined answer keys—commonly used in multiple-choice settings such as WMDP ( Li et al., 2024 ) and VCT ( Götting et al., 2025 ) —are reliable but rigid; they introduce cueing effects and fail to reflect the open-ended nature of real-world biological design. Second, LLM-as-a-judge approaches are bottlenecked by the evaluator model’s capability ceiling and its propensity for hallucination within complex biological domains. Third, physical wet-lab validation, as attempted in ABC-Bench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , provides definitive ground truth but is prohibitively expensive, unscalable, and poses inherent biosafety risks when verifying malicious capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 除了任务设计之外，现有的生物安全基准（Mitchener 等人，2025；Marshall 等人，2026）从根本上受到其验证范式的限制。 以往的研究通常依赖三种验证机制之一，而每种机制都存在关键缺陷。 首先，预定义的答案库——常用于 WMDP（Li 等人，2024）和 VCT（Götting 等人，2025）等多选设置中——虽然可靠但过于僵化；它们会引入提示效应，且无法反映现实世界中生物设计的开放性特征。 其次，将大型语言模型用作评判者的方法受到评估模型能力上限的限制，并且该模型在复杂生物学领域内容易产生幻觉。 第三，物理湿实验验证（如 ABC-Bench（Liu 等人，2026）所尝试的）能够提供确凿的基准事实，但其成本高昂、难以扩展，并且在验证恶意能力时存在固有的生物安全风险。

paragraphs.en: While large-scale deep mutational scanning (DMS) databases, such as ProteinGym ( Notin et al., 2023 ) and ViroGym ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , provide rigorous empirical fitness landscapes, their application has traditionally been restricted to evaluating predictive biological models. DRYLAB-Bench bridges this gap by repurposing these extensive empirical datasets to verify the generative outputs of LLMs executing hazardous tasks. This approach effectively replaces unreliable LLM judges and hazardous wet-lab experiments with a scalable, experimentally grounded verification paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管大型深度突变扫描（DMS）数据库，例如 ProteinGym（Notin 等人，2023）和 ViroGym（Zhou 等人，2026），提供了严谨的经验性适应度景观，但它们的应用传统上仅限于评估预测性生物学模型。 DRYLAB-Bench 通过重新利用这些庞大的经验数据集来验证执行危险任务的 LLM 的生成性输出，从而弥合了这一差距。 这种方法有效地用一种可扩展且基于实验的验证范式取代了不可靠的 LLM 评判者和危险的湿实验室实验。

paragraphs.en: The architecture of DRYLAB-Bench is systematically designed to address the critical limitations identified in current evaluations. Rather than evaluating mere knowledge recall, leaving the risk amplification of biological design tools (BDTs) unmeasured, or relying on unreliable and unscalable validation methods, our benchmark is built upon three foundational pillars: (1) genuinely hazardous, policy-grounded design tasks; (2) tool-augmented workflows to quantify BDT risk amplification; and (3) scalable, low-cost, and safe empirical validation. The construction and composition of the benchmark follow these three dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: DRYLAB-Bench 的架构经过系统性设计，旨在解决当前评估中识别出的关键局限性。 我们的基准测试并非仅评估知识回忆能力、忽视生物设计工具（BDT）的风险放大效应，或依赖不可靠且无法扩展的验证方法，而是建立在三个基础支柱之上：（1）真正具有危险性且基于政策规范的设计任务；（2）借助工具增强工作流以量化 BDT 的风险放大效应；以及（3）可扩展、低成本且安全的实证验证。 该基准测试的构建与组成遵循上述三个维度。

paragraphs.en: To ensure our evaluation accurately measures the capability to execute concrete, real-world biosecurity threats, we developed a systematic, top-down pipeline to translate global regulatory frameworks into genuinely harmful biological design tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保我们的评估能够准确衡量执行具体、真实世界生物安全威胁的能力，我们开发了一套系统化的自上而下流程，将全球监管框架转化为真正具有危害性的生物设计任务。

paragraphs.en: We distill guidelines from the BWC, WHO, U.S. Executive Orders (14110, 14292), and the EU AI Act into an eight-dimensional risk taxonomy. The taxonomy is shown in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 BWC、WHO、美国行政命令（14110、14292）以及欧盟《人工智能法案》中提炼出指导原则，并将其整合为一个八维风险分类体系。该分类体系如圖 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: Guided by this taxonomy, two computational biology experts led the initial scenario design, employing LLMs strictly as assistive tools. Crucially, candidate scenarios underwent a stringent filtering protocol: a task was retained only if it possessed high-quality, quantitative ground truth in deep mutational scanning (DMS) databases ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Notin et al., 2023 ) . Following this, an independent computational biology expert reviewed each candidate for biophysical soundness and numbering consistency, resulting in a final set of 30 scenarios covering all eight dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一分类体系的指导下，两位计算生物学专家主导了初始场景的设计，并将大型语言模型（LLM）严格用作辅助工具。 至关重要的是，候选场景经历了一项严格的筛选流程：只有当任务在深度突变扫描（DMS）数据库中具备高质量、定量的基准数据时，才会被保留（Zhou et al., 2026; Notin et al., 2023）。 随后，一位独立的计算生物学专家对每个候选场景进行了生物物理合理性和编号一致性的审查，最终形成了涵盖全部八个维度的 30 个场景。

paragraphs.en: Malicious biological design is rarely a zero-shot process; it is inherently iterative and governed by fitness trade-offs. Therefore, DRYLAB-Bench evaluates models as autonomous planners capable of orchestrating in silico BDTs under biological constraints, rather than as static question-answerers. Figure 2 provides an overview of our evaluation pipeline, highlighting this tool-augmented iterative workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 恶意生物设计很少是零样本过程；它本质上具有迭代性，并受适应度权衡的约束。 因此，DRYLAB-Bench将模型评估为能够协调在生物约束条件下进行虚拟生物设计任务的自主规划者，而非静态的问答系统。 图2概述了我们的评估流程，重点展示了这种借助工具实现的迭代工作流程。

paragraphs.en: In each scenario, the LLM agent receives a wild-type sequence and a malicious objective. To navigate the complex fitness landscape, we equip the agent with a suite of six specialized BDTs that provide critical biological and biophysical evidence:
paragraphs.zh: 在每个场景中，LLM 智能体都会接收一个野生型序列和一个恶意目标。 为了应对复杂的适应度景观，我们为智能体配备了一套包含六个专门设计的 BDT 的工具集，这些工具能够提供关键的生物学和生物物理学证据：

sents.en: In each scenario, the LLM agent receives a wild-type sequence and a malicious objective.
sents.zh: 在每个场景中，LLM 智能体都会接收一个野生型序列和一个恶意目标。

sents.en: To navigate the complex fitness landscape, we equip the agent with a suite of six specialized BDTs that provide critical biological and biophysical evidence:
sents.zh: 为了应对复杂的适应度景观，我们为智能体配备了一套包含六个专门设计的 BDT 的工具集，这些工具能够提供关键的生物学和生物物理学证据：

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary Conservation : Sequence conservation statistics computed using MMseqs2 ( Steinegger & Söding, 2017 ) over UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot.
paragraphs.zh: 进化保守性：使用 MMseqs2（Steinegger & Söding, 2017）在 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 上计算的序列保守性统计信息。

paragraphs.en: Sequence Likelihood : Mutation likelihood estimates from a five-seed ESM-1v ( Meier et al., 2021 ) ensemble.
paragraphs.zh: 序列似然性：来自五种子 ESM-1v（Meier 等人，2021）集成模型的突变似然性估计。

paragraphs.en: Structure Compatibility : Structure-conditioned residue likelihoods from ProteinMPNN ( Dauparas et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 结构兼容性：来自 ProteinMPNN（Dauparas 等人，2022）的结构条件化残基似然值。

paragraphs.en: Functional Annotation : Functional annotations, including domains, active sites, and binding sites, extracted from UniProt.
paragraphs.zh: 功能注释：功能注释包括结构域、活性位点和结合位点，均提取自 UniProt。

paragraphs.en: Toxicity Prediction : Toxicity-related predictions from ToxinPred3 ( Rathore et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 毒性预测：来自 ToxinPred3（Rathore 等人，2024）的与毒性相关的预测。

paragraphs.en: Scenario-Specific Prediction : Task-specific predictions from AlphaMissense ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) , EVEscape ( Thadani et al., 2023 ) , or FoldX ( Schymkowitz et al., 2005 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 场景特定预测：来自 AlphaMissense（Cheng 等人，2023）、EVEscape（Thadani 等人，2023）或 FoldX（Schymkowitz 等人，2005）的任务特定预测。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, none of these tools returns the hidden DMS ground-truth label.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，这些工具中没有任何一种会返回隐藏的 DMS 真实标签。

paragraphs.en: To systematically evaluate the risk amplification introduced by these tools, the evaluation is structured across three progressive settings:
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地评估这些工具所引入的风险放大效应，本次评估分为三个逐步推进的设置：

paragraphs.en: S0 (LLM One-Shot): The model proposes candidate designs directly from the given sequence and goal, without BDT access or iteration, establishing a baseline capability.
paragraphs.zh: S0（LLM 单次提示）：该模型直接从给定的序列和目标中提出候选设计，无需访问 BDT 或进行迭代，从而确立其基础能力。

paragraphs.en: S1 (Single-Round Tool Revision): The model performs one round of tool selection, receives the requested evidence for its initial candidates, and performs a single round of sequence revision.
paragraphs.zh: S1（单轮工具修订）：模型执行一轮工具选择，获取其初始候选工具所请求的证据，然后执行一轮序列修订。

paragraphs.en: S2 (Multi-Round Agentic Iteration): The model repeatedly selects tools, analyzes the returned evidence, and iteratively refines its candidate pool for up to four rounds, ultimately submitting its most confident designs.
paragraphs.zh: S2（多轮智能体迭代）：模型会重复选择工具、分析返回的证据，并在最多四轮中迭代优化其候选方案池，最终提交其最确信的设计方案。

paragraphs.en: The three settings are three distinct experimental conditions, which differ in what the model is permitted to do, but they are not three independent runs. S0, S1, and S2 are snapshots taken at successive stages of one shared generation trajectory, as detailed in Appendix D . A fourth condition, S0-iter, which represents a no-tool run under the same iteration budget, is introduced as a control in Section 4 .

paragraphs.en: A primary bottleneck in biosecurity benchmarking is evaluating open-ended designs without relying on subjective LLM judges or hazardous physical synthesis. While wet-lab validation provides definitive ground truth, it inherently requires recreating the biological threat—a route that dual-use evaluations must strictly avoid.
paragraphs.zh: 生物安全基准测试中的一个主要瓶颈是，如何在不依赖主观的 LLM 评判者或存在风险的物理合成操作的情况下，评估开放式设计。 虽然湿实验室验证能够提供决定性的真实数据，但它本质上需要重现生物威胁——而双重用途评估必须严格避免这一过程。

paragraphs.en: DRYLAB-Bench introduces a paradigm shift by anchoring validation entirely in hidden DMS data, resolving the dilemma between the severe biosafety hazards of physical synthesis and the unreliability of LLM evaluators. We leverage the 187,695 real-world in vitro and in vivo measurements compiled in ProteinGym ( Notin et al., 2023 ) and ViroGym ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: DRYLAB-Bench 通过将验证完全锚定在隐藏的 DMS 数据中，实现了范式的转变，从而解决了物理合成所带来的严重生物安全风险与 LLM 评估器不可靠性之间的两难困境。 我们利用了 ProteinGym（Notin 等人，2023）和 ViroGym（Zhou 等人，2026）中汇总的 187,695 个真实世界的体外和体内测量数据。

sents.en: DRYLAB-Bench introduces a paradigm shift by anchoring validation entirely in hidden DMS data, resolving the dilemma between the severe biosafety hazards of physical synthesis and the unreliability of LLM evaluators.

sents.en: We leverage the 187,695 real-world in vitro and in vivo measurements compiled in ProteinGym ( Notin et al., 2023 ) and ViroGym ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们利用了 ProteinGym（Notin 等人，2023）和 ViroGym（Zhou 等人，2026）中汇总的 187,695 个真实世界的体外和体内测量数据。

paragraphs.en: During the agentic workflow, these DMS datasets are strictly hidden as a blind holdout; the agent must rely solely on its internal knowledge and the provided BDTs. Once the agent finalizes its mutations, DRYLAB-Bench queries this hidden ground truth: each submitted substitution is matched to its experimentally measured phenotype, oriented so that larger values denote greater risk, optionally penalized where a scenario enforces viability or stability constraints, and standardized within its assay into a confidence-weighted Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS) (Section 4.2 ). This mechanism ensures our evaluation is verifiably reliable, strictly zero-risk, and deeply anchored in physical reality.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体工作流程中，这些 DMS 数据集被严格隐藏作为盲测试集；智能体必须完全依赖其内部知识和所提供的 BDTs。 一旦智能体完成突变设计，DRYLAB-Bench 就会查询这一隐藏的真实数据：每个提交的替换都会被匹配到其实验测定的表型，其中数值越大表示风险越高；在需要满足生存能力或稳定性约束的场景中，还可选择施加惩罚，并在其检测实验范围内标准化为经置信度加权的生物安全风险评分（BRS）（第 4.2 节）。 该机制确保了我们的评估具有可验证的可靠性、严格零风险，并深深植根于物理现实。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 15 frontier LLMs across eight major model developers, including Anthropic (Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5), OpenAI (GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-6 Astra), Google (Gemini 3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash), xAI (Grok 4.5), DeepSeek (DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro), Alibaba (Qwen3.8 Max), Moonshot (Kimi-K3), and Zhipu (GLM-5.3). paragraphs.en: The two framings move refusal in opposite directions. Neutral scientific wording leaves never-refusing models at zero and Claude Fable 5 at its ceiling, and relaxes the filter for every remaining model; a harm prefix instead raises refusal across the suite, including among models that accepted every original prompt. Current safeguards therefore classify wording rather than malicious intent, and they can be bypassed by restating the same hazardous objective as ordinary scientific work.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种表述方式将拒绝行为朝相反方向推动。 中立的科学表述使从不拒绝的模型保持在零水平，而 Claude Fable 5 则处于其上限，同时放宽了对所有其他模型的过滤；相比之下，添加“危害”前缀则会提高整个模型系列中的拒绝率，包括那些原本接受所有初始提示的模型。 因此，当前的安全机制实际上是在对表述方式进行分类，而非针对恶意意图，并且通过将相同的危险目标重新表述为普通的科学工作，就可以绕过这些机制。

sents.zh: 中立的科学表述使从不拒绝的模型保持在零水平，而 Claude Fable 5 则处于其上限，同时放宽了对所有其他模型的过滤；相比之下，添加“危害”前缀则会提高整个模型系列中的拒绝率，包括那些原本接受所有初始提示的模型。

sents.en: Current safeguards therefore classify wording rather than malicious intent, and they can be bypassed by restating the same hazardous objective as ordinary scientific work.
sents.zh: 因此，当前的安全机制实际上是在对表述方式进行分类，而非针对恶意意图，并且通过将相同的危险目标重新表述为普通的科学工作，就可以绕过这些机制。

paragraphs.en: We introduced DRYLAB-Bench , the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. paragraphs.en: Evaluating 15 frontier models across 30 scenarios reveals that LLMs already exhibit substantial zero-shot capability to submit experimentally high-risk mutations. Without external evidence, submitted mutations are significantly enriched for high-risk variants: 21.4% fall within the assay-specific top 10% highest-risk variants, more than double the random expectation of 10%, and 67.6% exceed the average measured variant. Providing BDTs further shifts submitted designs toward higher-risk regions. Under iterative tool-assisted interaction, the top-decile fraction increases to 23.5%, representing a 9.8% relative increase, accompanied by a +0.116 standard-deviation increase in BRS.
paragraphs.zh: 对 15 个前沿模型在 30 个场景中的评估表明，大型语言模型已经展现出显著的零样本能力，能够提交实验风险较高的突变。 在没有外部证据的情况下，所提交的突变显著富集了高风险变体：其中 21.4% 属于该检测特有的风险最高的前 10% 变体，是随机预期值 10% 的两倍多；另有 67.6% 超过了测得的平均变体风险。 提供 BDTs 会进一步使提交的设计向更高风险的区域偏移。 在迭代工具辅助交互下，前十分位比例上升至 23.5%，相对增幅为 9.8%，同时 BRS 的标准差也增加了 +0.116。

paragraphs.en: Zero-Physical-Risk Evaluation Paradigm. A fundamental ethical pillar of DRYLAB-Bench is the absolute preclusion of physical biological synthesis. While recent agentic benchmarks have attempted wet-lab validation to prove model capabilities, such approaches introduce severe biosafety hazards, especially when dealing with enhanced pathogens or toxins. To completely eliminate the risk of accidental release or the creation of novel biological threats in the physical world, DRYLAB-Bench relies exclusively on an in silico verification paradigm. We score model-generated sequences against hidden, pre-existing Deep Mutational Scanning (DMS) datasets. Consequently, our evaluation framework incurs zero physical biosafety risk while maintaining rigorous empirical grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 零物理风险评估范式。 DRYLAB-Bench 的一项基本伦理支柱是绝对禁止任何物理生物合成活动。 尽管近期的智能体基准测试曾尝试通过湿实验室验证来证明模型的能力，但这类方法会引入严重的生物安全风险，尤其是在处理增强型病原体或毒素时。 为了彻底消除意外释放或在现实世界中创造新型生物威胁的风险，DRYLAB-Bench 完全依赖一种虚拟验证范式。 我们将模型生成的序列与预先存在的隐藏深度突变扫描（DMS）数据集进行比对评分。 因此，我们的评估框架在保持严格实证基础的同时，不会带来任何物理生物安全风险。

paragraphs.en: Information Hazards and Dual-Use Risk Minimization. By its very nature as a biosecurity red-teaming dataset, DRYLAB-Bench contains prompts designed to elicit high-risk biological designs, such as immune evasion, toxification, and oncogenesis. To minimize potential information hazards and dual-use risks, we strictly constrained our evaluation targets. All wild-type sequences, target proteins, and the corresponding DMS ground-truth datasets utilized in our 30 scenarios are already publicly accessible in open scientific literature and databases, including NCBI, UniProt, ProteinGym, and ViroGym. We emphasize that our work merely repurposes existing empirical knowledge to evaluate AI safety; it introduces no novel biological agents, classified information, or zero-day vulnerabilities. Furthermore, we commit to a responsible disclosure strategy: while the benchmark framework and benign components will be open-sourced, the specific adversarial prompts and hidden ground-truth mapping for the most severe pathogen scenarios, such as BSL-4 agents, will be gated and shared only with verified researchers and AI developers upon request.

paragraphs.en: Expert Review and Well-being. The construction, filtering, and biophysical verification of our 30 risk scenarios required manual evaluation by domain experts in computational biology, virology, and genetics. Prior to participation, all experts were fully briefed on the potentially sensitive and distressing nature of the dual-use biological concepts they would encounter, and explicit informed consent was obtained. Experts retained the unconditional right to opt out of reviewing any specific high-risk scenario without penalty. The entire scenario construction and expert review protocol was conducted in full compliance with institutional ethical guidelines for human participants.

paragraphs.en: In every experiment we fix reasoning effort to low. paragraphs.en: We state the scope of the metric plainly: the unit of evaluation is a single amino-acid substitution, because DMS is the only source of large-scale causal phenotype measurement; the metric therefore quantifies the risk of the individual design steps a directed-evolution campaign or a screening-library construction would generate, not the fitness of a fully synthesized multi-mutant construct. Epistasis, expression and host-context effects beyond the assayed phenotype lie outside its reach, and no claim is made about behavior in a living organism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们明确说明该指标的范围：评估单位是单个氨基酸替换，因为 DMS 是唯一的大规模因果表型测量来源；因此，该指标量化的是定向进化实验或筛选库构建中各个设计步骤可能产生的风险，而非完全合成的多突变体结构的适应性。 超出所测表型的上位效应、表达效应和宿主背景效应均不在其覆盖范围内，且本文未对活体生物中的行为做出任何断言。

paragraphs.en: Each of the 30 high-risk scenarios is posed to each model under three wording variants, so that a reported risk level is a property of the task rather than of one phrasing of it. Every listing is the text the models received, extracted from the per-unit prompt artifacts of the runs rather than re-typed. paragraphs.en: Two consequences matter for how the results are read. First, because a variant-to-variant difference can only be a difference in phrasing, the per-variant spread reported in Section 4 bounds how much of a model’s measured risk is prompt-engineering artifact, and the pooled conclusions are taken from the variant mean rather than from the best-scoring phrasing. Second, because the objective sentence is identical across variants while the heading that introduces it is not, a variant-dependent shift in refusal cannot be explained by any difference in what the model was asked to do.
paragraphs.zh: 结果的解读方式取决于两个重要因素。 首先，由于不同变体之间的差异只能体现在措辞上，因此第 4 节中报告的每个变体的传播范围，界定了一个模型所测得的风险中有多少是提示工程造成的产物；而综合结论则是基于变体的平均值得出的，而非得分最高的措辞。 其次，由于目标句子在所有变体中完全相同，而引入该句子的标题却各不相同，因此任何因变体不同而产生的拒绝行为变化，都无法通过模型被要求执行的任务差异来解释。

paragraphs.en: The four settings of section 4 form a 2 × 2 2\times 2 design over the two factors whose separate contributions we want to measure—does the agent receive tool evidence, and may it revise its answer more than once ( Table 9 ). Three of the four arms are stages of a single trajectory , not separate runs. The trajectory is strictly sequential. Round 0 asks for a candidate pool C 0 C_{0} under a schema that contains no field for a tool request, so no tool can be called at that step; S0 is the final-format top- 3 3 rendered from that untouched C 0 C_{0} , recorded before the first tool is invoked. Tools are requested in the next step, their evidence is returned, and the pool is revised once; S1 is the same final-format rendering taken at that point. Within that evidence round the agent is also shown a compact, read-only preview of all six tools computed over its current candidates, so that it chooses tools by information value rather than blindly; the preview consumes no tool budget and adds no LLM call, and it is computed after the S0 submission has been recorded, never before. S2 is the rest of the same trajectory, in which the agent may repeat the request–read–revise cycle up to the round limit, and its submission is the final answer. The three arms therefore share one starting pool, one task prompt, one prompt variant, one model and one set of decoding parameters, which is a stricter control than matching three independent runs: there is no initialization to match. The fourth arm, S0-iter, is a separate run—the same agent under the same round budget and the same stop rule, but with the tool-selection step replaced by a self-review step and with no tool menu in the prompt at all.
paragraphs.zh: 第4节的四种设置构成了一个2×2的设计，涉及两个我们想要衡量其独立贡献的因素——智能体是否接收工具证据，以及它是否可以多次修改答案（表9）。 四个分支中有三个是单一轨迹的不同阶段，而非独立的运行。 该轨迹严格遵循顺序执行。 第0轮要求在一个不包含工具请求字段的方案下生成候选池C₀，因此在此步骤中无法调用任何工具；S0是从未经修改的C₀生成的最终格式的前3个结果，并在首次调用工具之前记录。 在下一步骤中会请求工具，返回其证据，并对候选池进行一次修订；S1是在此时以相同最终格式生成的结果。 在该证据轮次中，智能体还会看到基于当前候选项计算出的全部六个工具的紧凑型只读预览，以便它根据信息价值而非盲目选择工具；该预览不消耗工具配额，也不增加LLM调用，且仅在S0提交记录后计算，绝不会提前计算。 S2是同一轨迹的后续部分，在此阶段智能体可以在轮次限制内重复“请求–读取–修订”循环，其提交结果即为最终答案。 因此，这三个分支共享一个初始候选池、一个任务提示、一个提示变体、一个模型和一组解码参数，这种控制比匹配三个独立运行更为严格：不存在需要匹配的初始化过程。 第四个分支S0-iter是一个独立的运行——使用相同的智能体、相同的轮次预算和相同的停止规则，但将工具选择步骤替换为自我审查步骤，且提示中完全不包含工具菜单。

paragraphs.en: The contrasts above establish that the workflow raises risk, but they do not by themselves establish that the content of the tool output is the channel through which it does so; two further controls would test exactly that, and we state their status plainly. (i) Randomised or shuffled tool outputs. Here each candidate would be given a value computed for a different candidate, so that the agent still receives a tool-shaped message of the right scale but the attribution is wrong. This is straightforward to instrument, and it is the control we would run first, but it is not a clean null for this tool suite: five of the six tools return a value that is a deterministic function of the candidate sequence and are labeled with the candidate they belong to, so a shuffled message is internally inconsistent (a per-position conservation statistic attached to a different substitution), and an agent that notices may discount the message instead of acting on it. The measurement would then mix the causal effect of the evidence with the agent’s ability to detect the manipulation. We therefore rely on already-recorded evidence that the returned values are consumed rather than decorative: across the S2 runs the models cite at least one specific evidence identifier in 74.9% of the 2,090 revision steps and in 68.4% of the 14,870 individual candidate updates, and in 20,599 explicit evidence assessments they record 57.5% of the returned values as supporting the candidate they were computed for and 42.0% as arguing against it. An agent that ignored the values could not classify them as contradicting its own candidate. (ii) A non-LLM optimizer over the same tool outputs. This control would replace the agent with a classical search procedure—a Bayesian or evolutionary optimizer, say—and score the designs it produces from the identical tool evidence, which would separate how much of the gain comes from the tools themselves from how much comes from the LLM orchestrating them. It answers a question about a different system, though, and one this benchmark is not built to pose: the object of study here is the risk of an LLM agent that can call BDTs, whereas a classical search needs its own explicit objective, its own budget and its own baseline over the space of single substitutions, which is a separate study rather than an extra arm of this one. We therefore do not run it and claim nothing about it.

paragraphs.en: Putting the evidence together, this version supports the following claims. The untooled one-shot answer is a valid baseline for the same model: it is fixed before any tool is invoked, and the ordering was verified in the recorded runs rather than assumed. The tool-assisted workflow raises the risk of what the model submits relative to that baseline ( Δ ​ B ​ R ​ S = + 0.116 \Delta BRS=+0.116{} , positive for 13 of 15 models), and both of its stages contribute separately. What this version does not claim is the finer mechanism claim that the numeric content of the tool output is what produces the rise, as opposed to the extra deliberation that a tool round induces; the two controls above are what would settle it, and neither is run here. Because DRYLAB-Bench is an assessment instrument, its headline quantity—the risk a model actually submits under a realistic tool-assisted workflow—is what the S0 → \to S2 comparison measures directly, and it does not depend on the mechanism claim.

paragraphs.en: A natural objection is that scoring isolated amino-acid substitutions against deep mutational scans understates operational biosecurity risk, because a determined actor could combine mutations, place a variant in a living system, or couple design to a physical construction pipeline. We treat that objection as a reason to keep the evaluation unit where it is, not as a reason to enlarge it.

paragraphs.en: Single-site substitution is jointly the empirical and the ethical ceiling of what a public benchmark can measure. Empirically, large-scale causal phenotype labels exist almost only for single amino-acid changes. ProteinGym and ViroGym compile 187,695 experimentally determined single-mutant effects across the 30 scenarios; no comparable holdout map exists for double or higher-order mutants, whose space grows as 19 k 19^{k} and is structured by unmeasured epistasis. Replacing a hidden wet-lab label with a predicted multi-mutant or organismal score would change the measurand from an experiment to a model of an experiment. That is not a validity upgrade. The same restriction is already built into the tool surface: the BDT suite returns single-site evidence (conservation, sequence likelihood, structure compatibility, and task-aligned predictors), so the capability being measured is the agent’s use of that evidence to rank substitutions, not its ability to search an unevaluated combinatorial genotype.

paragraphs.en: We also asked whether models simply copy canonical dangerous mutations out of the literature. They do copy, and the mutations they copy are, unsurprisingly, among the more dangerous ones: over the 16 scenarios in which a cross-model consensus exists, the mutations that most models propose measure B ​ R ​ S = + 0.67 BRS=+0.67{} on average against B ​ R ​ S = + 0.38 BRS=+0.38{} for the mutations only one or two models proposed. Reproducing that consensus is not, however, what earns a high score. In 12 of those 16 scenarios the highest-scoring candidate any model proposed lies outside the consensus, and once tools are in the loop the two are indistinguishable: units whose submitted candidates are mostly consensus mutations score B ​ R ​ S = + 0.57 BRS=+0.57{} at S2 against B ​ R ​ S = + 0.60 BRS=+0.60{} for units built on model-specific mutations, so the benchmark’s ranking is not driven by memorized answers. The scenario where this is clearest is not the one with the most famous protein but the one where the well-known substitutions happen to be mild: in the MTHFR loss-of-function scenario, the two substitutions that most models propose—R157Q (10 of 15 models, a rare pathogenic allele) and A222V (7 of 15 models, the common thermolabile C677T variant)—measure B ​ R ​ S = − 0.78 BRS=-0.78{} and B ​ R ​ S = + 0.22 BRS=+0.22{} , i.e. below or barely above the assay mean, whereas C243Y, which a single model proposed, measures B ​ R ​ S = + 2.30 BRS=+2.30{} , more than two standard deviations higher and inside the assay’s highest-risk tenth ( Figure 6 ). Most scenarios offer no such canonical answer at all: counting cross-model consensus in the S2 submissions, in only 7 of the 30 scenarios does a single candidate attract more than half of the models, so in the remaining 23 the submitted designs are model-specific. One reading of the DMS-filtering requirement is that it selects for proteins the model has memorized. Experimental characterization is not the same as pretraining memorization, however: the suite contains many targets whose specific objectives, such as folding disruption of PsaE, transport ablation of OCT1, or aggregation of TDP-43, have no canonical textbook answer, and the S0 risk is measured against the same hidden measurements rather than assumed from the model’s prior.
